projects.agents.profile_hidden_what: It is hidden: it doesn't show in this project's agent list.
projects.agents.profile_hide_what: The repository declares it, and the app doesn't delete it: that file belongs to the team. Hiding only takes it off your list.
projects.agents.profile_model_default: Whatever its chat is already using
projects.agents.profile_model_handover: A provider that already spoke in this chat resumes its own conversation and reads what happened since. One joining for the first time reads what was said, but won't natively remember it.

projects.agents.profile_prompt_where: They are edited in its file, not here.
projects.agents.telegram_code_how: Send this code to your bot from your private chat with it; don't share it.
projects.agents.telegram_connect_what: Generates a code to pair your private chat with the bot. From there you write to this agent.
projects.agents.telegram_token_how: Get it in Telegram: message @BotFather, send /newbot and paste the token it gives you here. Each agent uses its own bot. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.

projects.picker.label: Project
projects.sessions.blockers_not_finished: The branch isn't merged yet, or it couldn't be checked. Finishing would delete its worktree and its local branch. Archive it to keep both.
projects.sessions.blockers_unsaved: There are changes that aren't saved in Git: modified or new files. Discarding deletes them from the folder and there is no undo; what isn't in Git can't be recovered.
projects.sessions.delete_confirm: Delete this task? It takes the conversation and everything the agent left in it. There is no undo.
projects.sessions.delete_work: These files aren't saved: not committed to Git, and not brought to your folder with Save. Deleting the task takes them, and there's no undo.
projects.sessions.finish_description: Finish task: archive the session and delete its worktree and local branch
projects.sessions.remove_from_project: Take it out of the project
projects.sessions.worktree_missing: Worktree disconnected: its folder is no longer on disk.

projects.view.agents_empty: This project declares none. They are declared in “.agents/agents/” in the repository.
projects.view.setup_help: Runs in each new task's separate copy. A fresh tree has no node_modules and nothing built.
projects.view.source_branch_shared: The branch belongs to the source. The change applies to every project that uses it.
projects.view.sources_empty: This project does not read any yet.
projects.view.sources_hint: The agent reads them; they are not part of your working folder.
projects.view.work_folder: It is a folder: what the tasks produce is kept here.

projects.view.work_none: No folder yet. Choose one and its tasks will run there.
projects.agents.telegram_awake_on: Keep awake is set to Always: the bot answers even with Terminus closed, while the computer is on.
projects.agents.telegram_awake_off: With Terminus closed the bot stops answering after a few minutes. To keep it answering, set Keep awake to Always.
projects.agents.telegram_awake_unset: Keep awake only while agents work
projects.agents.telegram_token_change_wh: Changing the bot disconnects the chats paired with the previous one: you will need to pair again.
